head: A filter with
no exceptions
is untested.
body: The rule was right 99% of the time. The 1% was a parked delivery van, and it mattered more than the 99.
It has only met your test data.

head: The legitimate case
*it breaks
slides.caption: Any rule strict enough to be useful will be wrong for some real case. That is not a failure of the rule. It is what rules are.
